title: BiggerPockets Pro: What to Know
h1: What to know before you join BiggerPockets Pro
keyLine: Start free. Pay for Pro when the calculators or forms would save you hours.
description: A Legacy Investing Show briefing on BiggerPockets: free vs Pro, public 2026 prices, who it fits, and questions to ask. Not a customer review and not a star rating.
answer: This is not a shopper review. We did not join Pro for this page. BiggerPockets is a real estate media site. Forums and podcasts are free. Pro is the paid tier for more calculator use, forms, and extra content. A March 3, 2026 staff post said Pro is $32.50 a month billed yearly. A membership table also lists $39 a month. Use Pro if you are already looking at deals. Skip it if you have not picked a model yet.
criteriaIntro: We used BiggerPockets' own pages and a dated staff post. We did not scrape private member areas. We do not assign stars.
criteria: What is free vs paid, from public pages.
Price only where BiggerPockets published one.
Who should wait, based on the job, not on hype.

blocks.heading: Free vs Pro
paragraphs: Free: forums, many articles, and the main podcasts. That is enough to learn BRRRR (buy, rehab, rent, refinance, repeat), house hacking, and why a deal dies.

Pro: a membership comparison page lists extra calculator reports, state lease packages, webinar replays, and bootcamps. The same table shows some reports capped on cheaper tiers. We could not re-check a live logged-in dashboard, so treat feature lists as 'what they advertise,' then confirm at checkout.

The [bootcamps URL](https://www.biggerpockets.com/bootcamps) on September 15, 2026 was a free resource library plus a Pro upgrade prompt. If you were quoted $199 for a bootcamp, that figure appears on an older membership table. Ask them to show the live offer.

blocks.heading: Who should pay, who should wait
paragraphs: Pay when you are underwriting real listings most weeks and you want their calculators or forms in one login. Wait if you are still choosing between a rental, a short-term rental, and doing nothing. That choice is a [short-term vs long-term rental](/compare/short-term-rental-vs-long-term-rental) problem, not a membership problem.
Pro will not build you a tax plan. If that is the pain, use [tax strategies for real estate investors](/tax-strategies/for/real-estate-investors) or a CPA.

blocks.label: How this page is not a review
paragraphs: Google may show 'BiggerPockets review' for this URL. We are not a customer. We are a competing education brand. We tell you the public facts, then the questions we would ask. For our own proof page, see [reviews](/reviews).

blocks.heading: A 15-minute checklist
items: I can name the model I want (long-term, short-term, flip, or none).
I have used the free forums or podcasts for at least two weeks.
I know whether I need calculators, forms, or a class.
I have written down the monthly and yearly Pro prices from their live page, not from memory.
I am not paying with high-interest debt.

whoFits: You are close to buying Pro and want a briefing from a named author, not a star widget.
You already like the free content and you need a go or no-go.
whoSkips: You want an independent consumer-lab test. We are not that.
You have never visited the free forums.

questionsBeforeBuying: What exact feature am I paying for in month one?
Is there a trial, and what is the cancel path?
Do I need state lease forms, or will an attorney do that cheaper on one property?
Will I still need Pro if I only buy one house this year?
nextSteps: Use free content for two weeks and keep a note of blocked features.
Underwrite one listing with our [rental cash flow calculator](/tools/rental-property-cash-flow) even if you later pay for theirs.
If you want a human to review a wealth plan, that is not Pro. See [Legacy Wealth Blueprint](/legacy-wealth-blueprint).

faqs.a: It is a long-running real estate media company with a large public forum. That is not a promise that every post is good advice. Treat forum tips as leads, then check numbers and local law.

faqs.q: Do I need Pro to start?
faqs.a: No. Start free. Pay when a listed Pro feature is in your way every week.
It is a briefing written by Legacy Investing Show. It is not a customer review and it has no star rating.
